edits.replace: A closed TCP connection stays in TIME_WAIT for {{ nat_tcp_time_wait_default }} on new gateways and 120 seconds on existing gateways before its port can

| UDP | {{ nat_udp_default }} | `--udp-idle-timeout` |

Existing gateways keep a TIME_WAIT default of 120 seconds. The new default applies in all regions from 1 November 2026.

```bash
natctl describe my-gateway
```

To see the TIME_WAIT timeout in effect, read the `effectiveTcpTimeWaitTimeoutSec` field.
